title: cynodon dactylon var. glabratus
intro: Cynodon dactylon var. glabratus, commonly known as smooth buffelgrass or glabrous buffel grass, is a variety of the buffelgrass plant, a type of grass native to Africa, but widely distributed and naturalized in many parts of the world. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Cynodon dactylon var. glabratus include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
